sections.skill: Compare a side business and a full-time business

questions.prompt: Mia works 40 hours a week and wants to test a pet-sitting idea. Which plan has the lower personal risk?

choices.text: Borrow money to open a large pet hotel later this month
Sign a long lease for a pet store
Keep her job and pet-sit on weekends to test demand
Quit her job today to pet-sit full time

questions.correct_answer: Keep her job and pet-sit on weekends to test demand
questions.intro: A side business runs alongside a job or school. A full-time business is your main work and main income. A side business usually has less risk, because a paycheck or other income still covers living costs while you test the idea, but it has less time. A full-time business has more time but more risk: if sales are slow, personal bills may go unpaid. Many owners start on the side, then decide later using evidence such as steady sales, savings and a clear plan.
questions.feedback: Keeping her job while testing keeps her bills covered, so the personal risk is lower.

questions.prompt: What is the main tradeoff of a side business?

choices.text: No customers and no costs

questions.correct_answer: Lower risk to your income, but less time for the business

sections.skill: Side or full-time: time and risk

questions.prompt: Ana cleans homes on Saturdays and keeps her job. What kind of business is this?

choices.text: A side business
A corporation
A hobby only
A full-time business

questions.correct_answer: A side business
questions.intro: Picture two people starting a cleaning service. Ana keeps her job and cleans homes on Saturdays. Ben quits his job and cleans homes every day. Ana has fewer hours but still gets her paycheck, so slow weeks do not hurt her bills. Ben has many more hours to find customers, but a slow week means less money for rent and food. That is the basic tradeoff between a side business and a full-time business: time versus risk.
questions.feedback: It runs alongside her job, so it is a side business.

questions.prompt: Ben quit his job to clean homes every day. What is his main extra risk compared with Ana?

choices.text: He has fewer hours than Ana to look for customers.
